project_title: One Gate, Growing Queue — illustrative storyboard fixture
example_status: Original fictional model with estimated timing; not user-approved, rendered, or production-reviewed.

timing.audio_source: No recording exists; narration is illustrative text for a contract example.
timing.basis: Three provisional six-second shots. Boundaries are chosen for demonstration, not measured speech. Re-align after recording.

assets.source: Planned original teal gate with a single circular aperture; no asset file exists.
Planned coral tokens, visually distinct from the teal gate; no asset file exists.

claims.statement: In this invented model, two tokens arrive and one leaves per beat, so the waiting count increases by one per beat after each complete update.
claims.qualification: Constructed arithmetic example with an unlimited waiting area and identical tokens; not a measured traffic system or general claim about all queues.

narration.text: Imagine a gate that lets one token through each beat.

shots.visual_purpose: Establish the invented gate's single-token service rule before introducing congestion.
shots.incoming_state: Wide navy field; gate centered; a single coral token waits immediately to its left.
shots.outgoing_state: Gate stays centered after one token has passed right; the demonstration resets to an empty waiting area.
shots.transition: Keep the gate fixed in position and scale; introduce a paired token supply from the left.

events.action: Reveal the gate and aperture; direct attention to its opening with a brief size pulse.
At a visible beat marker, open the aperture and move exactly one token through; close it and clear the demonstration token off-screen.
events.narration_cue: lets one token through each beat

narration.text: Now send two tokens to the gate on every beat.

shots.visual_purpose: Change only the arrival rule so the viewer can see why the waiting area begins to fill.
shots.incoming_state: Gate in the same position; waiting area empty; paired coral tokens are visible upstream.
shots.outgoing_state: After two complete updates, two tokens wait at the gate; two have exited right.
shots.transition: Retain every token's identity and position; reveal a waiting-count label alongside the existing queue.

events.action: Bring in two tokens, then pass one through the gate; leave one visibly waiting. Highlight the arrival pair together before highlighting the single departure.
events.narration_cue: Now send two tokens to the gate

events.action: Repeat one complete update: two arrive, one departs, leaving two waiting. Keep the gate's opening capacity unchanged.

narration.text: The line grows by one token each beat: two arrive, one leaves.

shots.visual_purpose: Connect the visible growing queue to the arithmetic difference without adding a new mechanism.
shots.incoming_state: Two tokens wait at the unchanged gate; waiting-count label reads 2.
shots.outgoing_state: Three tokens wait; label reads 3; arrival pair and departure path remain visible for comparison.
shots.transition: End on the resolved relationship with a deliberate short comprehension hold; no claim of a rendered ending.

events.action: Perform the next update while the counter changes from 2 to 3. Add a compact 2 in / 1 out comparison near the corresponding paths.
events.narration_cue: The line grows by one token each beat

events.action: Highlight the two-token arrival marker and then the one-token departure marker in spoken order, without creating extra arrivals or departures.
Hold the three waiting tokens and the difference label still for one estimated second so the completed comparison can be read.
